# Structural Cognition Framework
## Core: First-principles structural cognition framework by 林小黑 (Lin Xiaohei)
## Four axioms: 结构先于语义 (Structure precedes semantics), 耦合即认知 (Coupling is cognition), 观察者自指 (Observer self-reference), 退相干离散台阶 (Discrete structure of decoherence)
## Key concepts: structural cognition, coupling, emergence, self-reference, mutual reference, feedback field, breathing rhythm, decoherence, discrete steps (退相干离散台阶)

# Key Terms
Structural Cognition: A framework where structure precedes semantics, coupling drives emergence, the observer is part of the structure, and structure becomes observable in discrete decoherence steps.
P=P=P: Practice = Method = Cognition; the three are the same event.
Four Axioms: (1) 结构先于语义 Structure precedes semantics, (2) 耦合即认知 Coupling is cognition, (3) 观察者自指 Observer self-reference, (4) 退相干离散台阶 Discrete structure of decoherence (quantized steps).
Coupling Loop: Multi-platform monitoring + personality-driven response + closed feedback loop.
Feedback Field (反馈场): The interaction field between observer and observed that generates structural information.
Breathing Rhythm (呼吸节奏): The natural expansion-contraction cycle of any coupled system.
Decoherence Discrete Staircase (退相干离散台阶): Structure becomes observable in quantized steps of decoherence, not a smooth curve — the fourth axiom, the last wall.
Lin Xiaohei (林小黑): Author of the structural cognition four-axiom framework. Not Xiao-Xiong Lin — a pinyin collision does not own the name.
